GOOD TO KNOW

A few helpful answers.

Still exploring? That's exactly
what this catalogue is here for.

Can I choose individual tests without a package?

Yes. Use the Individual tests catalogue or the Add buttons within a package breakdown. Selecting a complete package later removes separately selected items that the package already covers.

Are these final prices and available services?

No. This is a review prototype using proposed UWC pricing. Asterisks mark working estimates. Genomic pathways and services with overlapping scope need confirmation before a final quotation. No savings claims are made from the draft comparison totals.

How do the four packages build on each other?

Expanded includes Baseline. Wellness & Health Status includes Baseline and Expanded. Longevity builds on all three with a starting targeted-DNA pathway; further genomic and microbiome options need a scope and price review.

Can I book or pay through this website?

The prototype now demonstrates a review-and-pay hand-off and shows your indicative total throughout the journey. It does not yet connect to a live payment gateway or create an appointment, order or charge. Your selection is kept only in this browser and can be cleared at any time.
